async def act(page):
    # Click on 'Catalog' link to navigate or expand menu
    await page.get_by_role('link', name=' Catalog').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Check if a menu expanded by looking for menuitem roles
    reviews_menu_item = page.get_by_role('menuitem', name='Reviews', exact=False)
    if await reviews_menu_item.count() > 0:
        await reviews_menu_item.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    else:
        # If no menu item, search for a link with 'review' in name on the page
        review_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='review', exact=False)
        if await review_link.count() > 0:
            await review_link.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        else:
            # Fallback: look for any element with role containing 'review' text
            # Use get_by_role with filter if needed, but avoid generic locators
            # Since get_by_role doesn't support substring on role, use name filter
            all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
            for i in range(await all_links.count()):
                link_name = await all_links.nth(i).get_attribute('aria-label') or await all_links.nth(i).text_content()
                if link_name and 'review' in link_name.lower():
                    await all_links.nth(i).click()
                    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                    break
